zh-Hans:
失败工具卡片收起后保持选择，精简回复操作栏。独立二维 CAD 移除不适用的三维入口；三维草图编辑固定视角，退出后恢复。更新图片编辑器的调整、预览与导出。
编辑器 AI 助手与普通聊天分开；改善聊天列表的失败、受阻和待处理提示，以及流式回复结束和后台任务停止后的状态。
改善会议录音的实时字幕、说话人标记及离开页面时的继续或停止选择。改进工具箱显示与常用操作，路由跟踪可配合本地信息库显示 IP 地区和网络信息。
三维草图页可导入 DXF/DWG，也可从本 App 的二维 CAD 项目选择草图，将原生曲线和构造图形加入当前草图，原项目保持独立。
请重点检查助手归属、回复结束与等待提示、录音继续和停止、工具箱操作，以及 CAD 导入的源草图选择、实际尺寸、取消和一次撤销。CAD 仅复制图形，尺寸约束与关联留在原项目。
en-US:
Simplifies reply actions. Failed tool cards keep your manual collapse choice. Standalone 2D CAD removes unsuitable 3D actions; 3D sketch editing locks the view to its plane and restores it on exit. Updates image adjustments, previews and export.
Keeps editor AI assistants separate from ordinary chats. Improves failed, blocked and pending states in the chat list, plus state handling when streaming replies finish or background tasks stop.
Improves live recording captions, speaker labels and the choice to keep recording or stop when leaving. Refines toolbox displays and common actions; Traceroute can show IP region and network information using a local database.
The 3D sketch page can import DXF/DWG or a selected sketch from a 2D CAD project in Floe, adding native curves and construction geometry to the current sketch while keeping the original separate.
Please check assistant ownership, reply completion and waiting states, recording continuation and stopping, toolbox actions, and CAD source selection, actual size, cancellation and one-step undo. CAD copies geometry; dimensions, constraints and links stay in the source.
